post.summary: Give an agent identity to another member. Admins only, confirmed with a passkey.
Let a suspended agent identity act again. Admins only, confirmed with a passkey.
End an agent identity for good with its credentials, its pending approvals and its running work. Its owner or an admin may, confirmed with a passkey.
Stop an agent identity from acting until it is resumed. Its owner or an admin may.

get.summary: List the organization’s approval routes in match order, the default last.

post.summary: Create an approval route. Restricting deciders needs a group target.

delete.summary: Delete an approval route. The default route cannot be deleted; deleting a restrictive route needs a passkey confirmation.

get.summary: Read an approval route.

patch.summary: Change an approval route. Making it looser (no group restriction, no four-eyes, switched off) needs a passkey confirmation of the exact change.

post.summary: Show which route a call would take and who it would reach, without posting anything.
Start a passkey confirmation of one decision on a held call. The challenge is bound to the call’s digest, the decision and any grant; it works once, for the member who asked.
Decide a held call with the passkey assertion that answers a challenge for exactly this decision. A token cannot decide; deny needs the assertion too.

get.summary: What the approver may choose in "Also allow": whether this held call can be trusted for the rest of the agent session, for how long, and toward which targets. Computed by the server; the choice goes into the decision.
The active trusts for agent sessions: a person sees those on their own sessions; an administrator may ask for the organization’s.

delete.summary: End one trust. Ends it at once; the next matching call is held for an approval again. A person may end the trusts on their own sessions, an administrator any.

post.summary: End every trust on the caller’s own sessions, or with `scope=org` every trust of the organization (administrators).

get.summary: List auth configs.

post.summary: Create an auth config.

delete.summary: Delete an auth config. One with connected accounts is refused unless an admin in the browser passes force, which revokes and removes the accounts.

get.summary: Read an auth config. Secret values are never returned.

patch.summary: Change an auth config.

post.summary: Disable an auth config: new connections are refused, existing accounts keep working.
Enable an auth config.

put.summary: Replace secret fields. Values are write-only.

post.summary: Set new secret values and keep the previous ones for a grace period.

get.summary: Your linked chat accounts.

delete.summary: Unlink one of your chat accounts. Another member’s link answers 404.

patch.summary: Opt a linked chat account in or out of direct messages.

get.summary: List the connected Slack workspaces and Teams tenants, and whether each provider is set up on this deployment.

delete.summary: Disconnect a workspace or tenant: its tokens are deleted and the routes that post to it are switched off.

patch.summary: Change an installation’s settings. Showing argument values in chat or allowing shared channels needs a passkey confirmation.

get.summary: The channels the bot can post to in a workspace, for the route editor’s picker.

post.summary: Link exactly the members a preview listed. A changed list, or a preview already used, is refused.
Look members up in Slack by their verified-domain address and list who would be linked. Nothing is linked yet.

get.summary: Who can decide approvals and whether each of them can be reached in chat.

post.summary: Post a card marked TEST to a channel. It creates no approval and asks for no decision.
Create a link an end user opens to connect an account. The address is shown once and works until it expires.

get.summary: Read a link’s status: initiated, completed, failed or expired.
List connected accounts.

post.summary: Bring in a connection the product already holds: an API key, basic login or bearer token, or the refresh token of its own OAuth app. The account is active at once.
Import up to 1,000 connections as a job. Read each row’s outcome from the job.

delete.summary: Disconnect an account: the grant is revoked at the provider where the connector allows it, then the stored credential is deleted.

get.summary: Read a connected account. Credentials are never returned.

patch.summary: Rename an account or make it the primary one for its owner and service.
Push new credential values for an account made from credentials the product holds. Named fields are replaced, a null removes one, omitted fields stay.

get.summary: List the email domains the organization has claimed.

post.summary: Claim an email domain. It counts once the DNS record in the answer is published and verified.

delete.summary: Release a claimed domain.

post.summary: Look up the DNS record and verify the domain when it is there. One organization at a time can hold a domain verified.

get.summary: List the project’s end users, optionally those whose id starts with a search text.

post.summary: Create an end user by the product’s own id for them. Creating the same id again returns the existing end user.

delete.summary: Erase an end user: grants revoked, credentials, sessions, memory, files and passkeys deleted. Runs as a job; the answer is 202.

get.summary: Read an end user by the product’s id for them.

patch.summary: Set or remove the email used to verify the person before they enroll a passkey.

get.summary: The changes servers made to what they offer.
One change with its diff and what the screening found.

post.summary: Accept waiting definitions across several servers in one passkey decision, up to 500.

get.summary: Servers configured on devices that the firewall does not govern.

post.summary: Ask an administrator to add a server.

get.summary: List the servers behind the firewall.

post.summary: Add a remote server or a hosted package and approve it.

delete.summary: Turn a server off, or turn a request down.

get.summary: Read one server: its settings, its endpoints and how it is hosted.

patch.summary: Change a server’s settings, tags or exposure.

get.summary: The calls, refusals and decisions recorded for a server.

post.summary: Approve a requested server: register it, or build and start a hosted package.

get.summary: List the tools, prompts and resources a server offers, with their state.

patch.summary: Set a tool’s risk class or its allow setting.

post.summary: Approve or reject waiting definitions; approving needs a passkey.
Build and start a hosted package again, for instance after its variables changed.
Ask the server what it offers now and compare the answer with what is pinned.

get.summary: The names of the variables a hosted package starts with; never their values.

put.summary: Replace the variables a hosted package starts with; an empty set removes them.

post.summary: Hold every call to a server.
Lift the hold on a server; needs a passkey.

get.summary: List the organization's jobs, newest first. A member sees the jobs they started; an administrator sees all of them. No job input is returned.
Read a job: its status and counts and, for a batch import, the outcome of every row. A project key sees the jobs the product started; a member sees their own, an administrator the organization's.

post.summary: Stop a job and the branches it started. A job that already finished is returned unchanged.
Start a failed or dead job again with the same input. Administrators only.
Write a draft page from an agent run or workflow run the caller may read. The draft is saved unpublished in a space the caller can edit.

get.summary: A document indexed from another tool, if the caller is one of its readers in that tool. The read is audited.
Read a page and its Markdown by id; a version may be named.

patch.summary: Publish, archive or return a page to draft.

get.summary: List the readable pages that link to a page.

delete.summary: Remove a page grant.

get.summary: List the grants on a page.

put.summary: Give a user or a group a role on one page, overriding the space role; `none` removes access.

get.summary: A page as sanitized HTML. Wikilinks to pages the caller cannot read are not links.

post.summary: Copy a personal page into an organization space as a draft for its editors to review; the personal page links to the copy. An admin may do this for a departed member’s page until their space is deleted.

delete.summary: Remove a run link from a page.

post.summary: Link a page to a skill, workflow or schedule it explains.

get.summary: The skills, workflows and schedules a page links to that the caller may run, with the last run of each.

post.summary: Mark a page as checked by the caller and start its next review period. Needs the editor role.

get.summary: List a page’s versions, newest first.

post.summary: Add a version; refused when the page moved on since `expected_version`.

get.summary: Search the pages the caller may read. `mode` is `full_text` when meaning-based ranking is not available, with the reason.

post.summary: Try embedding the pages again, for example after fixing the organization’s key or switching the embedding model. Admins only.

get.summary: Where the organization’s search stands: which embedding model it ranks with, and why it is on full text only when it is.
List the tools indexed into the knowledge base. Admins only.

post.summary: Index a tool into an organization space. Documents keep the readers they have in the tool. Admins only.

delete.summary: Stop indexing a tool and remove its documents and passages, unless they are under legal hold. Admins only.

get.summary: One source with its last sync. Admins only.

patch.summary: Rename a source, change its schedule or what it indexes, or pause and resume it. Admins only.

get.summary: The documents of a source with how many readers each has; `adminOnly` is set when no reader could be matched to anyone. Admins only.

delete.summary: Stop syncing a source on provider changes; the scheduled sync continues. Admins only.

put.summary: Sync a Google Drive or GitHub source the moment the provider reports a change. Admins only.

post.summary: Sync a source now. Admins only.

get.summary: List the knowledge base spaces the caller may read.

post.summary: Create an organization space.

get.summary: Read one space.

patch.summary: Change a space’s name, default access or review period.

get.summary: The pages of a space the caller may read as a ZIP of Markdown files an Obsidian vault can open, base64 encoded.

delete.summary: Stop syncing a space with Git. Admins only.

get.summary: The Git repository a space is kept in step with, and how the last sync went. Admins only.

put.summary: Keep a space in step with a folder of a repository the Zuano GitHub App can reach. Commits become page versions by their authors, who must be members who can edit the space. Admins only.

delete.summary: Stop syncing a space on pushes; the hourly sync continues. Admins only.

put.summary: Sync a space the moment its repository branch is pushed to. Admins only; needs access to manage the repository's webhooks.

post.summary: Sync a space with its repository now. Admins only.

get.summary: The readable pages of a space and the wikilinks among them.

post.summary: Add the Markdown files of a ZIP (base64 encoded) to a space as pages, or as new versions of the pages with the same slugs. Needs the editor role.

delete.summary: Remove a user’s or a group’s role in a space.

get.summary: List who has a role in a space.

put.summary: Give a user or a group a role in a space.

get.summary: List the pages of a space that the caller may read.

post.summary: Create a page; its Markdown is version 1.

get.summary: Read a page and its Markdown by space and slug.
The workflows and schedules the readable pages of a space link to, with the pages that link to each and the last run.
What the knowledge base holds per space, and the embedding tokens spent this month. Admins only.

post.summary: Link the chat account of a link ticket to the signed-in member. Needs a passkey confirmation; a ticket works once.
Who a link ticket would link, in which workspace, to the signed-in member. Changes nothing and does not use the ticket up.
Return an installation to an earlier version.

get.summary: Read the update an installed listing has available and the installation’s update settings.

put.summary: Choose how an installation follows new versions.

get.summary: Search the workflow marketplace.
Read one listing with its published versions.
Estimate what running a listing’s workflow costs.

post.summary: Announce the date a listing stops being offered.
Start installing a listing; answers with the address that finishes the install.
Report a listing to its publisher and the platform.

get.summary: Read the reviews of a listing.

patch.summary: Edit the organization’s own review of a listing.

post.summary: Review a listing once the organization has run its workflow.
Mark a published version deprecated with an optional note.
Withdraw a published version for a stated reason; installs stop receiving it.

get.summary: Read the organization’s publisher profile with the proofs it has given.

patch.summary: Edit the publisher profile.

post.summary: Create the organization’s publisher profile.

get.summary: List the publisher’s listings with their standing.
List the reports made about the publisher’s listings.

delete.summary: Remove the registered signing key.

put.summary: Register the public key the publisher signs versions with.

post.summary: Start proving control of a domain; answers with where to publish the proof.
Check whether the domain proof is published.
Send a confirmation message to the publisher’s support address.
Confirm the support address with the token that was sent to it.
Answer a report made about the publisher’s listing.
Reply once to a review of the publisher’s listing.
Submit a workflow version to the marketplace for review.

get.summary: List the publisher handles that are off limits.

post.summary: Put a publisher handle off limits.

delete.summary: Lift the flag on a publisher handle.

post.summary: Withdraw any publisher’s published version for a stated reason.

get.summary: List every publisher with its tier, standing and listing count.

patch.summary: Move a publisher between the community and verified tiers.

delete.summary: Reinstate a suspended publisher.

post.summary: Hide a publisher’s listings for a stated reason.

delete.summary: Show a hidden review again.

post.summary: Hide a review with a reason its author can read.

get.summary: List the submissions waiting for a platform administrator, elevated ones first.

post.summary: Approve a submission or ask for changes.

get.summary: List the organization’s projects.

post.summary: Create a project.

delete.summary: Delete a project and revoke its keys.

get.summary: Read a project. A server key may read its own project only.

patch.summary: Change a project’s settings, or suspend and resume it.

post.summary: Make a new secret for verifying the signed parameters a connect link adds to the callback address. It is shown once; the old one stops working at once.

get.summary: List a project’s keys. Secrets are never returned.

post.summary: Create a server key. The token is shown once.

delete.summary: Revoke a key.

get.summary: List the runs you started, newest first, or every run of the organization with scope=all (administrators). Skill evaluation runs are left out unless include=eval.

One run with its output, the governed calls it made and, for an agent run, its transcript. Another member's run is answered as not found, except to an administrator, who sees its metadata but not its output.

post.summary: Stop a run that is still going. Its token stops working at once and an agent loop notices before its next model or tool call.

Send a message to an agent run that is going. A steer message is read before the run's next model call; a follow_up is read when the run would otherwise finish, and the run goes on. Up to 20 messages of 4 KB per run. Only the person who started the run, or an administrator, may send one; agent credentials may not.

get.summary: The SCIM base URL of the organization and its tokens.

post.summary: Create a SCIM token. The token is in the answer once and cannot be read again. Confirmed with a passkey.

delete.summary: Revoke a SCIM token. The identity provider using it stops being able to provision at once.

get.summary: The fields and scopes needed to create an auth config for a service.
List the project’s saved session configs.

post.summary: Save a session policy under a name, to apply to many sessions by `configId`. It may only tighten the organization’s policy.

delete.summary: Delete a saved config. Sessions that used it keep the policy they have.

get.summary: Read a saved session config.

patch.summary: Rename a saved config or replace its policy; either starts a new version. Live sessions keep their policy unless `propagate` is true, which applies the new one to each and writes a history entry.

get.summary: List the project’s sessions, optionally one end user’s.

post.summary: Create a session for an end user: the policy their agent runs under. A policy can only tighten the organization’s.

delete.summary: Delete a session: its tokens stop working and it is gone.

get.summary: Read a session. A session token reads its own session only.

patch.summary: Change a session’s policy. Maps and policy blocks replace, the other blocks merge, null clears. A stale expectedConfigVersion is a 409 and changes nothing.

get.summary: Every version of a session’s policy, newest first.

post.summary: Report how an authorized custom call went, for the session’s log and the audit trail. Custom calls are not metered.
Ask whether the builder’s process may run one of the session’s custom tools with arguments of this digest. A write or destructive tool is held for a person; nothing is run by the gateway.

Run one tool in a session. A call that waits for an approval, a connection or a choice of account answers input_required with a requestState; send it back with the same tool and arguments to continue. The same Idempotency-Key returns the first outcome.

get.summary: List the files of the session, newest first. Only code running in this session reads or writes them, and they are deleted with it.

post.summary: Start an upload into the session’s folder: returns the address to send the bytes to, then complete the upload.

delete.summary: Delete one file of the session.

get.summary: A short-lived address to download one clean file of the session.

post.summary: Confirm the bytes arrived; the file is scanned before it can be downloaded or used by code.

get.summary: What happened in the session, newest first: tool calls, approvals and runs with their status, risk and duration. Never arguments or results.
List what the session remembers, by key.

delete.summary: Forget one key.

get.summary: Read one remembered value.

put.summary: Remember a JSON value of at most 16 KB under a key. A session keeps at most 256 keys; the memory is gone with the session.

get.summary: List a session’s tokens. Secrets are never returned.

post.summary: Mint a token for one session. It lasts at most 24 hours and is shown once; a dpopJkt binds it to a key.

delete.summary: Revoke a session token.

get.summary: The tools the session’s policy lets it run, named `<service>.<tool>` with their input schemas, for handing to a model API.

post.summary: Start connecting a Slack workspace: returns the Slack address to send the admin to. Needs a passkey confirmation of the install.

delete.summary: Remove the single sign-on connection. Confirmed with a passkey.

get.summary: Read the organization's single sign-on connection.

put.summary: Create or change the single sign-on connection. Confirmed with a passkey.

get.summary: The most recent sign-in attempts through the connection, newest first.

post.summary: Start a test sign-in. Open the returned address in this browser; the connection can be turned on after one succeeds.
Start connecting a Microsoft 365 tenant: returns the Microsoft admin consent address to send the admin to. Needs a passkey confirmation of the connection.

get.summary: The events a connected service can send: each type’s config, the JSON Schema of its payload and a sample.
One trigger type.
List the project’s trigger instances. Each filter takes a comma-separated list; disabled instances are left out unless asked for.

post.summary: Create a trigger instance for one end user: a catalog trigger type fed by the account that user connected. Its events are delivered to the project’s subscriptions and stream.

delete.summary: Delete a trigger instance and remove its hook at the provider.

get.summary: Read a trigger instance.

patch.summary: Turn a trigger instance on or off, or rename it. Turning one on needs its provider hook to be in place.

post.summary: Try the provider again for an instance whose hook could not be made.
Make the ingress endpoint of a custom OAuth app. Repeating the call for the same app returns the endpoint that exists.

get.summary: Read an ingress endpoint.

patch.summary: Change the setup fields named in the request. The address never changes.

put.summary: Set every setup field of the app’s endpoint. The address never changes.

get.summary: The fields an OAuth app of the project needs for its events, and its endpoint if one exists. Field values are written once and never returned.
List the project’s subscriptions.

post.summary: Subscribe an https address to the project’s events. The signing secret is shown once.

delete.summary: Delete a subscription.

get.summary: Read a subscription.

patch.summary: Change a subscription’s address, event types or description, or pause and resume it.

post.summary: Make a new signing secret, shown once. The old one keeps verifying for a day.

browserSession.description: A signed-in member session or member key.
